ReplaceUserStationsRequest.description: PUT /users/{id}/stations: the user's complete set of station assignments (an empty list withdraws them all).
ReplaceUserStationsRequest.title: ReplaceUserStationsRequest

StoreDeviceRequest.description:
POST /devices: enrol a pad or till by the fingerprint it will send as X-Device-Id (globally unique, including
soft-deleted rows: a fingerprint is a physical device).
StoreDeviceRequest.title: StoreDeviceRequest

StoreStationRequest.description: POST /stations: one station per code per branch (Shared's stations table), named in both languages (rule 9).
StoreStationRequest.title: StoreStationRequest

StoreUserRequest.description:
POST /users: a person of the admin's branch with one role, optional direct permission overrides, an optional short
code (checked again for uniqueness by ShortCodes) and a locale.
StoreUserRequest.title: StoreUserRequest

UpdateUserRequest.description:
PATCH /users/{id}: any subset of the editable attributes, the role, and the direct permission overrides (sent as
the complete new list). Phone is not editable here: it is the login id.
UpdateUserRequest.title: UpdateUserRequest

user_id.description: the pad may name the person whose code is typed (per-user lockout) and, before enrolment, its branch
